name: digup-windows
description: Describe it. Dig it up. File search by meaning for Windows with Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2

scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/worker', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/worker/digup_worker.py', 'dist/worker/digup_worker.py');"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
